Nadia, I found six ticket references on Vantorre Group (the parent) across the three sources. I left out Vantorre Mobility's #4812 and Quillfeather's #PD-4402.

| Ticket | What it is | Source |
|---|---|---|
| **#8841** | Gideon said he closed it on Jul 1, after a browser-cache problem on the kiosk tablets. The Detention Summary report was also discussed. | #strategic-pod, Jul 1 |
| **#PD-8841** | Two missed carrier check-ins at the Allentown plant (Gate 4, 2nd shift). | Moss digest 4/27 |
| **#8841** | Listed as still open. It's a gate kiosk timeout at Allentown (Dock Door 12, 2nd shift). | Moss digest 5/4 |
| **#8841** | Mateo Quiroga's ticket about drivers who can't select Dock Door 14 on the kiosk, at the Newark facility. It was escalated to platform engineering. | Moss digest 9/30 |
| **INC-4821** | Hartford kiosk outage on Aug 3. Gideon attached the status-page access screenshot to it. | #inc-vtg-hartford, Aug 3 |
| **VT-55120** | Root-cause ticket for the Hartford kiosk outage. It holds Carrowmere's gateway route finding and the reconnect log. | #inc-vtg-hartford, Oct 14 |
| **#PD-4418** | `Carrier_Dwell_Summary` export dropping timestamps for Dock Door 9 at the 04:00 shift changeover. | Moss digest 9/15/2025 |

- **#PD-4418:** the digest only says "the account Nadia runs". Nadia ran Vantorre Group then, so I think it's the parent, but the digest never names the account.
- **#8841:** the number appears four times with different details. The details are the Jul 1 closure, then Allentown Gate 4, then Allentown Door 12, then Newark Door 14. It's open on 5/4 and again on 9/30, after Gideon said he closed it on Jul 1. I can't tell from these sources whether it's one ticket or a reused or mistyped number. Please check the support system before the steering committee.
- **Hartford:** the Aug 3 Moss digest describes the Hartford Sev 1 but gives no ticket number.
- **Other digests:** the remaining digests have no Vantorre Group ticket numbers.
- **Coverage:** I read only the #strategic-pod channel, #inc-vtg-hartford and the Moss digest files. I didn't check the support system itself.
